title: Donate page says nothing to people who already give monthly
what_happened: I scrolled all the way down to Continue to Payment. The whole page is about starting a new gift. There's no "already a monthly donor? change or manage your gift" link and no contact for changing it. Picking an amount here looks like it would start a second gift on top of mine.
expected: A line near the Monthly toggle or the Continue button, like "Already giving monthly? Change your amount here" (a Stripe customer portal link), or at least an email or phone number to call.

title: Only route to change a monthly gift is a general contact page
what_happened: The only way I found to change my amount was the Contact Us page, which lists one general email and phone. It says it's for volunteering, partnering and programs, and never mentions donors or changing a gift. There's no donor login and no self-service link.
expected: A self-service "manage my monthly gift" link, or at least a line like "To change or pause a monthly gift, email X" so I know I'm writing to the right place and won't be told to cancel.

title: Home page news strip slides on its own, so I can't tap the item I want
what_happened: The only news I could see on the home page is a thin strip that rotates every few seconds. I picked the July 2026 Bulletin, and by the time I tapped it had slid to another item. Twice. The titles are also cut off ("July 202...", "Reyna S...").
expected: A strip that stops moving when I touch it, or a plain list of recent news with full titles and dates, and a clear News link in the menu.

title: No News or Stories item in the main menu
what_happened: I opened the menu to look for news. It has Who We Are, What We Do, Where We Work and Get Involved (Contact Us, Trips, Collective Narrative, Store), but nothing called News, Stories or Updates. I ran out of patience before I read a single dated news item.
expected: A clear "News & Stories" item in the menu leading to a dated list, newest first.
